QuestInfo.name: [Solatum] A Butcher's Work
QuestInfo.0: The trail of corpses seems to lead into the #btemple#k... Whatever's responsible for this may still be inside. Head in after finishing your investigation here.
QuestInfo.1: Enter the #btemple#k and whatever awaits you.
QuestInfo.2: Inside the temple, a lone woman stood before the corpse of Thenia. She was an #bApostle#k of Gerand Darmoor. Obssessed with strength and the will to survive, she fought you to the brink, with a smile on her face all the while.
